name: Signal Clearance Validation
description: Validates that signal-clearance correctly issues JWTs and that the issued JWT grants access to protected resources. Session refresh requires the httpOnly seti_refresh cookie which plot-test cannot maintain as a server-side mTLS client — refresh is exercised by the system's own session management.
author: claude-sonnet-4-6-session-20260410

steps.description: Gateway health check confirms SETI is up before exercising auth
Dev login issues a sec-wr4ngler JWT — gateway proxies to signal-clearance
Use JWT on a protected endpoint — confirms clearance grants access to Policy application registry
